verdict.rationale: Wise Business clearly provides account and routing numbers via its multi-currency account and 'global account details' feature (wise-docs-9, wise-docs-25/38), letting a finance-lead view these details. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of an on-demand bank verification letter or statement-generation feature tied to account/routing numbers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of generating a verification letter, self-serve letter/PDF download tied to account details, and any confirmation this is available 'anytime'.
